text: Today I went to get a brace removed because it was poking my cheek. Honestly, I walk past this place every day and trusted them to cut off the excess brace. The brace was poking me, so I went to get it removed. I couldn't go to my usual place because it's far away, so I went to a clinic in a mall. I thought it would be better, but the result was they dislodged my bracket. Two doctors worked on it. The first doctor, probably a female student nurse, took quite a while. She had me open my mouth, turn to the left, and used pliers to pry it open. When she finished, she asked if there was any more, and I said yes because the sharp brace was still poking me. Then the male doctor came in and said the bracket had come loose. He asked if I had done it myself or when it came loose, and the female doctor replied, "It didn't come loose before the procedure." So that means it came loose while they were working on it. I paid for it; it wasn't free. There was no apology, and they didn't even ask if I had dislodged it myself. Wouldn't I have noticed if it came loose?
